purpose: Freeze information sufficiency, event-level outcome metrics, time-clustered diagnostics and deterministic PASS/FAIL logic for DC_RAW_RATIO_ONSET_V1 on consumed folds 0-2 before any transition outcome is read.

fold1.role: consumed independent mechanism replication and development

event_construction_lock.P: immediately preceding joint trading session; do not skip backward over missing/suspended stock bars
event_construction_lock.same_security_episode_suppression: suppress new event from start D through its fixed D+10 target date inclusive

same_date_universe_baseline.definition: For each fold and signal date D, arithmetic mean exact-horizon return of all finite-return PIT-eligible, tradestatus=1 securities in that fold on D.
same_date_universe_baseline.reason: Keep the baseline deterministic and aligned with prior foldwise same-date market-relative diagnostics.

compressed_non_onset_baseline.definition: On the same fold/date D, securities satisfying the finite/tradable P and D requirements and DUAL_COMPRESSED on D but NOT satisfying the P-to-D onset transition.
compressed_non_onset_baseline.purpose: Measure whether eventization adds timing information beyond occupancy of the raw dual-compressed state.
compressed_non_onset_baseline.dates_below_minimum_controls: excluded from incremental timing diagnostic only; they remain eligible for event-vs-universe analysis

per_event.D10_excess_universe: event D10 return minus same-date fold-universe D10 mean
per_event.D5_excess_universe: event D5 return minus same-date fold-universe D5 mean

per_signal_date.D10_onset_excess_mean: mean D10_excess_universe across valid onset events on D
per_signal_date.D5_onset_excess_mean: mean D5_excess_universe across valid onset events on D
per_signal_date.D10_incremental_timing_spread: mean onset-event D10 return minus mean compressed-non-onset D10 return on dates with >=20 valid compressed non-onset controls

fold_aggregate.primary: equal-weight mean across valid signal dates of D10_onset_excess_mean
fold_aggregate.secondary: equal-weight mean across valid signal dates of D5_onset_excess_mean
fold_aggregate.incremental: equal-weight mean across valid diagnostic dates of D10_incremental_timing_spread
fold_aggregate.quarter_primary: equal-weight mean D10_onset_excess_mean within each valid calendar quarter
fold_aggregate.leave_one_valid_quarter_out_primary: equal-weight mean D10_onset_excess_mean after excluding each valid quarter in turn

event_metrics.reason_for_date_weighting: A transition can cluster across many securities on one market date; equal date weighting prevents a synchronized market transition day from dominating merely by event count.

bootstrap_diagnostic.procedure: Within each fold, resample valid signal dates with replacement; when a date is selected, retain all valid onset-event observations and recompute the date-weighted aggregate.
bootstrap_diagnostic.reason: Consumed folds are development evidence; fresh confirmatory significance is reserved for untouched fold3.

development_PASS_requires_all: All minimum-information conditions pass independently in folds 0, 1 and 2.
Primary mean D+10 onset excess versus same-date universe is > 0 independently in folds 0, 1 and 2.
D+10 incremental timing spread versus compressed non-onset occupancy is > 0 independently in folds 0, 1 and 2.
Positive valid-quarter primary D+10 share is >= 2/3 independently in folds 0, 1 and 2.
Every leave-one-valid-quarter-out primary D+10 mean is > 0 independently in folds 0, 1 and 2.
Secondary mean D+5 onset excess versus same-date universe is > 0 in at least two of the three folds.
No source, PIT, calendar, identity, event-suppression or implementation blocker exists.

terminal_logic.if_PASS: V2_8_9_TRANSITION_DEVELOPMENT_PASS; freeze the exact implementation and a separate pre-fold3 confirmatory contract before any fold3 access.
terminal_logic.if_FAIL: V2_8_9_TRANSITION_DEVELOPMENT_REJECTED; fold3 and fold4 remain sealed.
terminal_logic.if_INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION: V2_8_9_TRANSITION_DEVELOPMENT_INCONCLUSIVE; do not relax thresholds post-result and keep fold3/fold4 sealed.

implementation_validation_required_befor: Locked evaluator must bind this gate and the V2.8.9 hypothesis-gate candidate id exactly.
Deterministic self-tests must verify P is the immediately previous joint trading session and never a skipped-back stock bar.
Self-tests must verify D+1 or later data cannot affect event construction.
Self-tests must verify same-security D through D+10 suppression.
Self-tests must verify date-weighted aggregation and clustered bootstrap determinism.
Self-tests must verify fold3/fold4 are absent from source configuration.
Evaluator hash and validation receipt must be frozen before real folds0-2 execution.
forbidden: No coefficient fit or machine learning.
No event-count threshold relaxation after seeing results.
No bootstrap-CI or p-value rule added after seeing development results.
No fold3/fold4 price or outcome retrieval.
